projects.title: Thomson Reuters: product reimagination
projects.description:
Thomson Reuters has long been a leader in providing services for aggregating, organizing and analyzing scholarly publication data. The data behind InCites is world class, but the presentation of the information and product workflow has yet to reach its maximum potential.

We led a one-week “elaboration phase” workshop at their offices where we engaged people from sales, design, development and management roles to discuss the future of the InCites product. The basic goal was to help them better use their data as a resource to develop a beautiful product.

projects.title: Measuring interdisciplinarity at Northwestern University
projects.description: As a means to encourage its students to pursue an interdisciplinary curriculum, The Graduate School at Northwestern University created the Interdisciplinary Clusters in the Humanities and Non-Quantitative Social Sciences program. The clusters actively encourage students to enroll in classes across traditional discipline boundaries, enriching the educational experience of its students. The question is, how much of an impact will the Interdisciplinary Clusters have on cross-discipline enrollment? To address this question, we designed an interactive dashboard that allows prospective students to “touch” the interdisciplinary fabric at Northwestern.
